notes.title: Devblog / Updates #9
notes.content: [h1]Greetings blacksmiths![/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050600/ffc710a700410da6f84190c98de2f976bebd8f8a.png"][/img][/p][p]Long time no post, for me this more usual state. I think the most interesting time to post when we have something from 1-3 months of work. [/p][p][/p][p]For this time we've been added basic running mechanic and fishing mini-game. After a boring job / study, tooolsto and I are working on the game for a few hours, and this is why is everything goes so slow. But, the developing process is keeping going, even if I do not post on Steam for a long time. Also, I keep posting random stuff from the game on X, YouTube, and TikTok where you can check our last updates.  [/p][p][/p][p]So, we're still working on Anvil and Anvil mini game. For anvil mechanics, we want to add different materials for creating swords made of dirt or wood. This material will affect the final item, so you will need to know the order very well to estimate your wishes for the quest.  [/p][p][/p][p]Workbench, yeah, again we're improving the workbench. This modular craft system is really hard to achieve because of a lot of items which we want to add to the game, and we need to think how to make this happen. However, we want to add magic stuff to our game; this one will be created in the workbench, and we are really excited for this one.  [/p][p][/p][p]So hope you're doing great and have a nice summer![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers! [/p][p]BadBarian [/p][p][/p][p]p.s.      [/p][p]This summer is melting me...[/p]

notes.title: Devblog / Updates #8
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings fellow blacksmiths![/h1]

I haven't written devblogs for a long time, the reason is clear as day, I'm drowning in my studies and it's harder for me to find time for my tasks.

But why am I talking about myself, yes, in the blacksmith we continue to do unnecessary things, just now we finished with the mechanics of running and falling. Now when you run for a long time, your stamina runs out and you fall face down into the ground or bricks. We'll post on social networks and Discord soon.

I really hope that in March we'll start speeding up with the Anvil and the mini-game. There, about 50% is ready, but it's still very raw.

I really want to show the Anvil and its features, but alas, we're waiting for March.

p.s.

If there's been no information from us for a long time, then most likely it's just because of work and business, but we never forget about the blacksmith and try to devote time to it almost every day.

Cheers!

notes.title: Devblog / News #5
notes.content:
[h1]Heyy blacksmiths! How is your week?[/h1]

Yesterday we had a good impact from the twitter / X posting after being silent for almost a year. I'm glad to see new members here, welcome brothers and sisters! 🍻 

[url=https://twitter.com/BadSmithTheGame/status/1789915292560179235] here you can see workbench again but we added a water.[/url]

What we are working right now?🔥 

After a workbench, we decide to take a little break from hard task like modular craft system and work on visual aspects of the game such a water, fog and day/night time. I'm not thinking it takes the same amount of time which it takes for workbench, because we have already added some shaders and objects there just need to edit and polish.

For X profile and Discord, I will post more random stuff from the game. I wish to show all cool ideas or mechanics, but I am not a God. ( Or am I? 👀 )

We are feeling well and working slowly, but certainly we are developing BadSmith. 💪
